summary: Lebanon Lookout Tower appears as a landmark on a 1955 USGS map near Lebanon Station, Levy County; no source found on its build, staffing or current state.

events.note: Shown as the Lebanon Lookout Tower on a USGS topographic map dated 1955 and published 1956.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: a 1955/56 map landmark and a listing with no notes. Build date, design, staffing, fate and access are all unknown, so the story is near the bottom of the length range. The anyplaceamerica.com listing (Lebanon Forestry Site Tower) returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text and WebFetch and was not read. The map calls it a lookout tower, not a forestry site, so the anyplaceamerica name is unverified.
